title: MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HYFT) Added to the Russell 3000E Index, Expanding Institutional Investment Opportunity
summary: Inclusion in FTSE Russell's June 2026 semi-annual reconstitution expands visibility among institutional investors and broadens eligibility for index-tracking funds managing more than $12 trillion in benchmarked assets MindWalk Holdings Corp. (“MindWalk”) (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced that it has been added to the Russell 3000E Index, effective after the U.S. market close on June 26, 2026, as part of the FTSE Russell June 2026 semi-annual Russell US Indexes Reconstitution. Membership was reconfirmed in index data published June 29, 2026. The Russell 3000E Index is FTSE Russell's broadest measure of the U.S. equity market, covering up to the 4,000 of the largest U.S.-domiciled public companies by market capitalization.
